# Fix double callback on maxResponseSize and add maxRequestSize & hasSizeError

1. When an outgoing request body or incoming response payload exceeds the configured byte threshold, return an Error whose code property is set to ETOOLARGE. Size-limit errors must terminate the request and must not trigger automatic retries.

2. Implement a chainable maxRequestSize(n) method on Request to enforce byte-accurate size limits on outgoing request bodies, covering .send(), req.write(), and multipart form data. A size error is raised only when the payload byte size strictly exceeds the configured threshold.

3. Implement a hasSizeError() method on Request that returns a strict boolean indicating whether either an outgoing request or incoming response size limit was exceeded.

4. For multipart uploads, enforce Content-Length size limits and emit upload progress events.

Implemented in:

- [request-base.js](/app/src/request-base.js)
- [node/index.js](/app/src/node/index.js)
- [client.js](/app/src/client.js)

Highlights:

- Added chainable `maxRequestSize(n)` and strict-boolean `hasSizeError()`.
- Enforced byte-accurate limits for `.send()`, `.write()`, multipart `Content-Length`, and browser XHR.
- Added multipart upload progress enforcement.
- `ETOOLARGE` errors now terminate requests, never retry, and invoke callbacks only once.
- Preserved exact-threshold success behavior.

Verification: focused HTTP/1 and HTTP/2 tests pass; broader suite has 359 passing with 2 unrelated IPv6 environment failures.
